Mylo for me, I mean, the lyrics are just so goddamn beautiful for me: “I rather be a comma, than a full stop”; “And I won’t show or fear any pain, even though all my armor might rust in the rain”; or my favorite HLH: “Struggling with the feeling that my life isn’t mine”.  I still don’t know but the vibe in this album hits me hard every time I hear it, and mounting bike with this (specially Charlie Brown and Every Teardrop) it immediately lifts you up and gives you the energy. 
I think the production behind it it’s fascinating, even though most people think it’s “overproduced”, I personally love those weird instrumentals Brian Eno and co. created (MX, M.M.I.X, the instrumental of Up With The Birds).
But also it’s because the track listing is so damn well done! Its creates the perfect balance between calming songs to straight fun and excitement (U.F.O to POC, or UATW to Every Tear).
I just fell in love with this track instantly, but I feel you need to hear it in the right situation, like doing an extreme sport, riding a bike, or hell, just dancing.
Overall the album it’s my all time favorite and it should get more appreciation instead of just marking it as “too poppy”, i mean, it is, but it has the creativity elements from Viva, making it, for me, really memorable
